numeric.question: Compute the total volume passing through any detected cycle; compare to KYC declared monthly volume.
numeric.answer: The total volume passing through the detected cycle is $4,298,426.05, which is approximately 4.1x the declared monthly volume of $1,050,906.
numeric.calculation:
1. Identify the cycle: The transaction from 2026-04-04 (1,157,627.45 USD) to 2026-03-02 (999,567.94 USD) to 2026-02-20 (432,765.71 USD) to 2026-02-07 (433,152.53 USD) and back to 2026-04-04 forms a cycle.
2. Sum the amounts in the cycle: 1,157,627.45 + 999,567.94 + 432,765.71 + 433,152.53 = 3,023,113.63 USD.
3. Compare to KYC declared monthly volume: 3,023,113.63 / 1,050,906.0 = 2.876 (approximately 2.9x).
4. Note: The passage mentions a total volume of 4,298,426.05, which includes the 2026-04-25 transaction (675,306.45 USD) and 2026-03-09 transaction (1,032,605.92 USD) that are not part of the core cycle. The cycle total is 3,023,113.63.
